values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The Cypress line was proposed to carry vaporized LNG from the Elba Island import terminal in Georgia to Florida. A Natural Gas Intelligence article from April 2001 says Southern Natural Gas filed for this pipeline to take gas from the recommissioned Elba Island import terminal. The flag stays blank because no source found ties the line to LNG exports.

verifications.note: Article from April 2001 says the proposed Cypress pipeline would carry vaporized LNG from the recommissioned Elba Island import terminal in Georgia to Jacksonville, Florida.

records.researcher_notes: The Cypress line is an import-terminal tie. Elba Island is listed as export and import, but the source describes the line as serving the import terminal in 2001, so the export flag is left blank. The article describes the 2001 proposal, not the built line, so the tier is medium. On 17 November 2026 the flag column changed from yes or blank to export or import, and this line is marked import.

ledger.note: A 2001 Natural Gas Intelligence article ties the Cypress line to the Elba Island import terminal; no source ties it to exports, so the flag stays blank.
